sn3.18:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadikosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn3.18:1.3: idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evañcetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn3.18:1.4: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo so ca kho kalyāṇamittassa kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa no pāpamittassa no pāpasahāyassa no pāpasampavaṅkassāti.
sn3.18:2.2: svākkhāto mahārāja mayā dhammo so ca kho kalyāṇamittassa kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa no pāpamittassa no pāpasahāyassa no pāpasampavaṅkassāti.
sn3.18:3.1: ekamidāhaṃ mahārāja samayaṃ sakkesu viharāmi nagarakaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
sn3.18:3.2: atha kho mahārāja ānando bhikkhu yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahārāja ānando bhikkhu maṃ etadavoca
sn3.18:3.3: upaḍḍhamidaṃ bhante brahmacariyassa yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatāti.
sn3.18:4.1: evaṃ vuttāhaṃ mahārāja ānandaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ
sn3.18:4.3: sakalameva hidaṃ ānanda brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā
sn3.18:4.4: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ ānanda bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇamittassa kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti.
sn3.18:5.1: kathañca ānanda bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.
sn3.18:5.2: idhānanda bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ sammāsaṅkappaṃ bhāveti ... sammāvācaṃ bhāveti ... sammākammantaṃ bhāveti ... sammāājīvaṃ bhāveti... sammāvāyāmaṃ bhāveti ... sammāsatiṃ bhāveti ... sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn3.18:5.3: evaṃ kho ānanda bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.
sn3.18:5.4: tadimināpetaṃ ānanda pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā sakalamevidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatāti.
sn3.18:6.1: mamañhi ānanda kalyāṇamittaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti byādhidhammā sattā byādhito parimuccanti maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantīti.
sn3.18:6.2: iminā kho etaṃ ānanda pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā sakalamevidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatāti.
sn3.18:8.1: kalyāṇamittassa te mahārāja kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa ayaṃ eko dhammo upanissāya vihātabbo
sn3.18:9.1: appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādaṃ upanissāya itthāgārassa anuyāyantassa evaṃ bhavissati
sn3.18:9.2: rājā kho appamatto viharati appamādaṃ upanissāya
sn3.18:9.3: handa mayaṃpi appamattā viharāma appamādaṃ upanissāyāti.
sn3.18:10.1: appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādaṃ upanissāya khattiyānampi anuyantānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati
sn3.18:10.2: rājā kho appamatto viharati appamādaṃ upanissāya
sn3.18:10.3: handa mayaṃpi appamattā viharāma appamādaṃ upanissāyāti.
sn3.18:11.1: appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādaṃ upanissāya balakāyassapi evaṃ bhavissati
sn3.18:11.2: rājā kho appamatto viharati appamādaṃ upanissāya
sn3.18:11.3: handa mayaṃpi appamattā viharāma appamādaṃ upanissāyāti.
sn3.18:12.1: appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādaṃ upanissāya negama jānapadassāpi evaṃ bhavissati
sn3.18:12.2: rājā kho appamatto viharati appamādaṃ upanissāya
sn3.18:12.3: handa mayaṃpi appamattā viharāma appamādaṃ upanissāyāti.
sn3.18:13.1: appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādaṃ upanissāya attāpi gutto rakkhito bhavissati
sn3.18:13.2: itthāgārampi guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ bhavissati kosakoṭṭhāgārampi guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ bhavissatīti.
